thought.text: Only 9 tables — that's suspicious for 12,235 changesets. Let me investigate:

reasoning_content:
Wait a moment — only 9 tables? Liquibase said 12235 changesets were executed with 5169 rows affected, but only 9 tables exist. That's suspicious. Hmm, could it be that most of the changesets were `sql` or `sqlFile` against other objects? No, actually, in a PostgreSQL table listing, only 9 relations were shown. This is odd for XPlanBox, which should have hundreds of tables (xplandb has many tables).

Wait — maybe psql's \dt got truncated by head -20? No, it displayed a total of "9 rows".

Hmm, so Liquibase "successfully" ran 12235 changesets, yet only 9 tables were created? Let me look at the changelog files — maybe most of the changesets use `<createTable>` with schema… or maybe the changesets are conditional? Or maybe the tables were created in a different schema (not public)?

Let me check all schemas and table counts, and look at the changelog contents.

action.command: su - postgres -c "psql -d xplanbox -c \"SELECT table_schema, count(*) FROM information_schema.tables GROUP BY 1;\""; su - postgres -c "psql -d xplanbox -c \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM databasechangelog;\""; head -60 /opt/liquibase-5.0.4/xplan-database-scripts/9.3/*.yaml 2>/dev/null | head -40
